messages:
meera_sales: Hey team — need guidance on a one-off quoting exception for a POC with NovaHealth. They want a month-long POC (hosted) + a short reserved burst for 2 weeks. Customer asked for a temporary 40% off list for the POC; they may convert to a committed Dedicated contract later. How do we handle this without changing the canonical rate card?

alex_m: @meera_sales for one-offs we usually do a SOW or an addendum that references the rate card but lists an exception. Need: customer name, POC dates, expected tokens/day or expected monthly ARR equivalent, and whether this discount is refundable.

meera_sales: Customer = NovaHealth Inc (enterprise prospect). POC window: 2026-05-10 -> 2026-06-10. Hosted baseline with a 14-day dedicated burst (50 vGPU-hours/day). Estimate ~120M tokens for the month (~$6k list). Asking for 40% off for the POC period only. Not refundable; credit if converted to commit. Link to quote draft: https://drive.redwood/nova/poc-quote-draft (internal)

jordan_finance: Need ARR equivalence and whether we should recognize any revenue upfront. If discount applied as a credit on conversion, finance needs rules for contra revenue and journal mapping. Also: if they convert within 90 days, what's the credit mechanics?

meera_sales: Plan is: if they convert to a 12m commit within 90 days, apply up to the POC-discounted amount as a one-time credit against first invoice. Otherwise no refund. Will that work?

rachel_legal: For exceptions we need a short addendum (1 page) that: 1) scopes POC dates 2) records discount % and non-refundability 3) credit-on-conversion clause with conversion window 4) data handling note for healthcare PII, and 5) signature block. I can draft but need confirmation about data residency and DPIA status.

sam_engine: Operational ask: the 14-day burst will need Dedicated capacity provisioning. If we allocate 50 vGPU-hours/day, ops needs 72h lead time to reserve on Dedicated. Also want to flag KV-cache warmup costs; that will push initial token cost up for first 48 hours.

alex_m: Assuming the economics above, Deal Desk can approve a temporary commercial exception if net program impact < $10k and it has Finance + Legal signoff. Please fill the internal exception form and tag me. Template: /templates/deal-exception-v2.docx. We'll issue an exception ID (DDS-) and a short SOW addendum.

deal_desk_bot: Checklist: [x] template chosen, [ ] finance approval, [ ] legal addendum, [ ] ops provisioning ETA, [ ] deal desk ID issued. Reply with "ready_for_dds" when all items are green.

meera_sales: Updated numbers in the draft (link above) and added POC schedule. ARR-equivalent for POC ~ $72k ARR pro-rata (used for internal approvals). I uploaded the draft SOW in the folder.

jordan_finance: FYI — provisional ok from finance on the credit-on-conversion structure. I need the explicit journal code and final numbers before we sign.

rachel_legal: I started the addendum draft, inserted DPIA question for NovaHealth. If they say no sensitive data will be transmitted, we can keep standard addendum; otherwise need a brief DPIA which adds ~3 business days to turnaround.

alex_m: Provisional deal desk approval granted pending legal + ops. Once legal posts the addendum and ops confirms the Dedicated reserve, I will create DDS-2026-459 and route for signatures.

meera_sales: Great — I'll get NovaHealth to confirm no PII for the POC, push the SOW link to them, and queue ops for reservation. Will mark "ready_for_dds" here when all green. :thumbsup:

sam_engine: Note: ops confirmed 72h lead time; please request reserve by 2026-05-03 to guarantee capacity.

meera_sales: ready_for_dds — legal addendum posted, ops reserve requested (ticket #OPS-1129), finance given final pro-rata numbers. Adding final quote with exception language now.

alex_m: Received. Creating DDS-2026-459 now and routing to signatures. Keep me posted if NovaHealth tweaks conversion window or asks for longer credit.

meera_sales: Will do. Thanks everyone — will update thread after signatures. :rocket:
